records.explanation: 謝豫章 is an office-title reference to Xie Shang's father, Xie Kun (謝鯤), who served as Yuzhang administrator. The Liu annotation (annotation-001) explicitly notes '(别見/鯤子)' identifying the subject as Kun's son, and annotation-002 states '人鯤之子也' (son of Kun). The main text says '謝仁祖年八嵗謝豫章將送客' — Xie Renzu (Xie Shang) at age 8, Xie Yuzhang (his father Xie Kun) was seeing off guests. This is an office-holder reference where the office title 豫章 (Yuzhang) designates the person who held that office, distinct from Xie Shang himself.
records.referent_role: Xie Shang's father, Xie Kun (謝鯤), who held the office of Yuzhang (豫章) administrator
